Sample Document for Testing

This is a comprehensive test document used for validating the document indexing and search functionality of the Vault backend system.

SECTION 1: Introduction
The Vault system enables users to index, search, and retrieve documents using semantic search powered by vector embeddings. This document serves as test data to verify that text extraction, embedding generation, and search ranking work correctly.

SECTION 2: Technical Content
Machine learning and artificial intelligence have revolutionized how we process and understand information. Natural language processing enables computers to understand human language, while neural networks can learn complex patterns from data.

SECTION 3: Sample Data
Here are some key terms that should be searchable:
- Knowledge management
- Semantic search
- Vector embeddings
- PostgreSQL database
- Full-text search
- Document retrieval

SECTION 4: Test Scenarios
This document should be found when searching for:
1. "machine learning" or "artificial intelligence"
2. "semantic search" or "vector embeddings"
3. "knowledge management"
4. "document retrieval"

The search system should rank results based on relevance and return accurate snippets from the matching sections.

SECTION 5: Edge Cases
Testing with special characters: café, résumé, naïve, €100, ©2024
Testing with numbers: 12345, 3.14159, 1,000,000
Testing with URLs: https://example.com, test@example.com

SECTION 6: Conclusion
This sample document provides comprehensive test coverage for text extraction, tokenization, embedding generation, and search accuracy.
